ASCF Automation Runbook

Build verification and release automation after receiving the new HF10 build path — all ASCF comparison modes

Self-contained — open from any folder

Screenshots are embedded in this file. Copy or email this HTML alone — images still display.

Release context (example)

Old build (HF09)\\INPNQASCFLB02\rel\10241\uif\ASCF_HF_10240pb01hf09
New build (HF10)\\INPNQASCFLB02\rel\10241\uif\ASCF_HF_10240pb01hf10
ASCF product version10.24.0.pb01
HF number10
Tool URLhttp://localhost:5000/crm (network: http://10.19.164.180:5000/crm)
Reports folder\\<your-pc>\c$\crm_compare_reports

Step 1

Open the received new build UNC path in Windows Explorer and confirm you have read access.

Step 2

Note the previous HF build UNC path to use as the Old build baseline for comparison.

Step 3

Double-click start_server.bat in the python_project folder (or the Desktop ASCF Compare Tool - Start shortcut) to start the automation tool server.

Step 4

Open http://localhost:5000/crm in Chrome or Edge (or the network URL on a shared server, e.g. http://10.19.164.180:5000/crm).

Dismiss the “Before you compare” dialog if shown.

Step 5

Check the Build Comparison checkbox on the home page.

Step 6

Check the ASCF application checkbox only (do not select CRM/AMSS, UXF/OMNI, or DEX).

Step 7

Paste the previous HF build path into the Old build field.

Old build: \\INPNQASCFLB02\rel\10241\uif\ASCF_HF_10240pb01hf09

Step 8

Paste the received new build path into the New build field.

New build: \\INPNQASCFLB02\rel\10241\uif\ASCF_HF_10240pb01hf10

Step 9

Optionally click Load ASCF base paths and use Use as Old / Use as New to populate paths from the version table.

The table lists known ASCF release roots — expand the table to see all versions.

Step 10

Select one ASCF comparison mode (mutually exclusive radio buttons): Full content comparison (default — full tree diff), Naming convention comparison (archive/JAR filename pairing), Archives (.ear/.war/.zip/.rpm/.jar) contents (deep member compare), or FOSS/Foundation (JAR Implementation-Version) (single JAR version check). When Full content is selected, the ASCF full — optional report options panel appears for class diff, manifest diff, config/text diff, and explicit size rows.

FOSS/Foundation mode: pick Foundation product or Foss product from the dropdown (fills Jar name) or type the JAR name manually. See the Feature reference section below for all optional fields.

Step 11

Click Run comparison and allow the progress tab to open (enable pop-ups if blocked).

Step 12

Watch Console Output until the comparison finishes and the HTML report opens automatically.

Step 13

Review the HTML report: use Expand all / Collapse all on report sections, check Added/Removed in New Build, archive content differences, and any optional manifest/class/config sections you enabled on the home page.

Full-content reports include quick navigation, side-by-side comparison table, and collapsible sections.

Step 14

Save or share the HTML report from \\YOUR-PC\c$\crm_compare_reports if sign-off is required.

Step 15

Optionally enable Environment Validation, enter SSH host/user/password and remote ASCF deployment path, and validate JAR Implementation-Version on the deployment server.

Step 16

After build verification passes, click Foundations Link on the home page (visible when ASCF is selected).

Step 17

In Step 1 (Prepare), select ASCF Product Version 10.24.0.pb01, enter HF number 10, and click Prepare Foundation Link.

Step 18

In Step 2 (Update), enter version 10.24.0.pb01, HF 10, month Jun, year 2026, creation date 20260609, then click Update Foundation Link.

Step 19

Click Update Index.html, enter ASCF version, HF number, month, and year, then submit.

Step 20

Click Update Javadoc.html, enter ASCF Product Version and HF number 10, then submit.

Step 21

Return to the home page, click Administrative Tool, fill hotfix details, and click Submit & Launch Automation.

Example: Hotfix 10.24.0.pb01_hf10, Release date 2026-06-09, Download URL 10240pb01hf10_download.html, Release notes ReleaseNotes/relnotes10_24_0_pb01_hf10.pdf

Step 22

Verify the pre-filled Foundation admin form in the opened browser window and click Add Hotfix to publish the release.

Feature reference — ASCF comparison options

ASCF comparison modes (select exactly one)

  • Full content comparison — recursive folder tree diff between Old and New HF builds; default for HF build verification. Produces a detailed HTML report with Added/Removed/Identical sections.
  • Naming convention comparison — pairs archives/JARs with the same logical name but different version suffixes; lists exact matches and missing-from-old/new.
  • Archives (.ear/.war/.zip/.rpm/.jar) contents — deep compare inside each archive; reports identical, different, only-in-old, and only-in-new archives with member-level details.
  • FOSS/Foundation (JAR Implementation-Version) — compares one JAR at a time using META-INF/MANIFEST.MF Implementation-Version between builds. Run once per JAR on your checklist.

Modes are mutually exclusive radio buttons — only one runs per comparison.

ASCF full — optional report options (Full content mode only)

  • JAR names for class diff — comma-separated JARs (e.g. AmdocsCore.jar); decompiles changed .class files with CFR and shows Perforce-style Java diffs in the HTML report (requires C:\cfr-0.152.jar or CFR on the server PC).
  • File patterns for text / config diffs — comma-separated patterns (e.g. app.json, *.yml, web.xml); adds a Text and config files changed section. Leave empty to hide unless default rules apply.
  • JAR names for manifest diff — comma-separated JARs or globs (e.g. scala*.jar, commons-lang3*.jar); adds a manifest Implementation-Version comparison table.
  • Explicit file sizes to compare — comma-separated archive paths or globs (e.g. AmdocsUIF.ear, *.war); forces old-vs-new size rows in the report even when not in the main diff set.

FOSS/Foundation mode — product pickers & retry

  • Jar name — type manually or let a dropdown fill it.
  • Foundation product — Amdocs Core, Process Manager, Security Manager, System Configuration, obfuscation-utility.
  • Foss product — commons-io, log4j-core, slf4j-api, jxbrowser, esapi, and other bundled FOSS JARs.
  • Max retries / Retry delay — network UNC access retry settings for slow shares.

Detailed FOSS adoption workflow: docs\ASCF_FOSS_FOUNDATIONS_ADOPTION_RUNBOOK.html

Other ASCF home-page helpers

  • Load ASCF base paths — version table with Use as Old / Use as New and Open in Explorer (localhost).
  • Copy build folders (ASCF) — copy Old/New HF folders to local disk before compare (faster on slow network paths).
  • Environment Validation — SSH to deployment host and verify JAR versions remotely.
  • Foundations Link — prepare/update Foundation portal pages after build verification.
  • Administrative Tool — submit new HF to the Foundation admin site.

HTML report — navigation & sections

  • Expand all / Collapse all — toolbar at the top of every comparison HTML report.
  • Quick Navigation — jump links to comparison table, missing files, identical files, etc.
  • Detailed Comparison Table — Beyond Compare style side-by-side status per archive/file.
  • Optional sections appear only when configured: manifest diff table, class decompilation diffs, text/config file changes, explicit size comparison rows.
  • Reports saved under \\YOUR-PC\c$\crm_compare_reports — share the .html file for sign-off.
